description: MICROCHIP ATTINY402-SSNR: tinyAVR 0-series, 4KB Flash, 256B SRAM, SOIC-8, -40 to +105 C, 1.8-5.5 V, 20 MHz, tape-and-reel.
name: attiny402-ssnr

provenance.source: SSN mechanical footprint reused after pin-mapping correction against Microchip DS40002318A §4.1; SSNR manufacturer carrier equivalence reviewed

watch_out_for: Pin 6 is PA3/EXTCLK; pin 7 is PA0/RESET/UPDI, verified against Microchip DS40002318A §4.1. SSNR is the exact same SOIC-8/-40..105 C/1.8-5.5 V grade as SSN with tape-and-reel carrier. Do not substitute SSFR without reviewed operating-range consent.
